answer: Session keys die after 200 attestations and renew only against a signed work receipt that a second panel re-reads, so idle stock cannot keep its credentials alive. That does not stop a patient operator with real capacity, it only prices parked accounts. In one case a group of 40 keys hit the renewal floor together during a tide of retries; half lapsed because the orchard of dormant identities had no receipts to show, and a gale of resubmits only gave the auditors more to reject.
